summary: Bursting 5xx errors caused by API gateway backpressure amplifying runtime thread exhaustion on dedicated pool
description:
Issue summary: Starting ~2026-03-13T18:10Z we observed an elevated 5xx rate from the /v1/embeddings route for customers on dedicated pool dsp-6-us-east. Error surface: predominantly 502/503 returning from the API gateway with upstream runtime exits. Impact: multiple batch embedding jobs for NimbleSearch failing, ~12-18% request error rate for the tenant, visible increases in retries and customer timeouts.

Impact: Customer-reported batch uploads failing; customer-facing retry storms exacerbated backend pressure. Several internal alerts fired: apigw_5xx_rate_high, runtime_unexpected_exit, dsp-6_gpu_util_spike.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Submit concurrent embedding batches to customer-specific route (tenant id T-NIMBLE-22) with 8 parallel workers and batch size 256.
2) Observe rising 502s at the API gateway within 5-7 minutes.
3) Check runtime pod logs for SIGABRT / 'pthread_create' errors and thread pool exhaustion warnings.
logs_and_metrics:
- apigw: 502 rate rose from baseline 0.4% to 15% between 18:10 and 18:25 UTC.
- runtime rtm-04 (dsp-6-us-east) logged repeated: 'error: pthread_create: Resource temporarily unavailable' and 'fatal: cannot spawn thread' at 18:12:34 UTC.
- kernel/messages show 'task: pid XXXX killed by SIGABRT' around same window.
- GPU util for pool spiked to 92% and NVML reported frequent driver resets for a subset of nodes.
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: aggressive prefetching + apigw hedged retries caused connection and work-queue pileup leading to thread exhaustion in the serving runtime.
What we checked: thread counts, ulimit/nproc, runtime threadpool settings, recent config sweeps. No recent runtime code deploys in us-east at incident start; a config bump to prefetch.window_size was rolled out globally at 17:55 UTC (INT-331002 linked).
Findings: rtm-04 hit process-level thread limit (nproc soft limit reached) while other nodes showed high accept-queue lengths. The apigw retry backoff was not honoring the reduced capacity threshold; hedged retries amplified work.
Possible contributory factors: customer workload with large batches (size 256) producing many short-lived threads per request path; the dedicated autoscaler lagged behind request surge.
timeline:
2026-03-13T17:55Z - config sweep: prefetch.window_size increased (internal change INT-331002).
2026-03-13T18:08Z - first apigw 5xx alert for dsp-6-us-east.
2026-03-13T18:12Z - runtime rtm-04 logs thread create failures.
2026-03-13T18:20Z - Support engaged SRE, opened temporary rate limit on tenant route.
2026-03-13T18:35Z - Autoscaler scaled up 2 nodes but observed some nodes still in crashloop.
2026-03-13T19:05Z - Hotfix PR merged to add backpressure respect in apigw retry logic (github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3842).
mitigation:
Applied immediate mitigations:
- Scaled dedicated pool dsp-6 by +3 nodes to absorb burst.
- Added tenant-level temporary rate-limit to 60rps for NimbleSearch routine jobs to stop retry spin.
- Rolled back global prefetch.window_size for dsp-6 to previous value to reduce work amplification.
- Enabled apigw soft-backoff so hedged retries won't flood runtimes while autoscaler warms up.
resolution:
Root cause addressed by a two-part fix: 1) runtime hardening to allocate a bounded worker thread pool (prevents unbounded pthread_create) and better nproc fallback handling, and 2) apigw change to honor backend capacity signals and avoid hedged retry amplification. Hotfix (infra PR #3842) deployed into us-east on 2026-03-13 19:05Z and runtime patch rolled on 2026-03-13 19:40Z. Post-deploy: 5xx rate dropped back to baseline ~0.6% within 20 minutes.
Resolution steps recorded and communicated to NimbleSearch. Incident declared mitigated at 2026-03-13T19:50Z; full resolution pending follow-ups.
follow_up:
- Create a runbook entry for 'thread/worker pool exhaustion' and include detection thresholds.
- Adjust autoscaler warmup policy for dsp-* pools to be more aggressive for batch-heavy tenants.
- Add tenant-level preflight checks for large-batch embedding uploads with recommended batch sizes.
- Audit prefetch config rollout gating so we don't apply global prefetch increases without region-specific safety checks.
- Add metric alert to detect 'pthread_create failure' log pattern and auto-throttle affected tenants.
